dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I want to cook Thai food. What ingredients do we need?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈkʊk ˈtaɪ ˈfuːd. ˈwʌt ɪnˈɡriːdiənts duː wiː ˈniːd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Let's look in your fridge. Do you have an onion?
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛts ˈlʊk ɪn jʊr ˈfrɪdʒ. duː juː ˈhæv ən ˈʌnjən?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, there's an onion. And there's some butter.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ðɛrz ən ˈʌnjən. ənd ðɛrz sʌm ˈbʌtər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: We don't need butter for Thai food.
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈdoʊnt ˈniːd ˈbʌtər fər ˈtaɪ ˈfuːd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. There's some garlic, too, and there are three eggs.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ðɛrz sʌm ˈɡɑːrlɪk, ˈtuː, ənd ðɛr ər ˈθriː ˈɛɡz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Perfect! Let's make garlic chicken with rice.
dialogue.reading: ˈpɜːrfɪkt! ˈlɛts ˈmeɪk ˈɡɑːrlɪk ˈtʃɪkən wɪð ˈraɪs.
